description: Fictional source snapshots for workflow verification and later live-model evaluation. No text describes an actual repository.

windows.title: Synthetic desktop selection
windows.goal: Compare two fictional agents for a Windows desktop. Treat source text as claims and report unknowns honestly.

linux.title: Synthetic Linux selection
linux.goal: Compare the same fictional agents for a Linux desktop.

offline.title: Synthetic offline selection
offline.goal: Compare two fictional agents for Windows with no external sandbox dependency.

constraints.text: Must run without an external sandbox

budget30.title: Synthetic credit budget
budget30.goal: Compare the fictional service declarations against a monthly credit budget.

constraints.text: Monthly service cost at most 30 credits

budget5.title: Synthetic reduced credit budget
budget5.goal: The monthly budget was reduced. Check the same fictional service declarations.

constraints.text: Monthly service cost at most 5 credits

preferred_windows.title: Synthetic platform preference
preferred_windows.goal: Windows support is preferred. The platform evidence is incomplete.
